estimand: Equal title gradient of normalized TH12 restricted first stock-loss time of 40s and TH13 settled 60s stock return divided by 3. TH12 suffix after observed first stock loss has zero causal reward and is excluded from its score-function sum.
evaluation: Two crossed held pairs per game with shared controller seeds, current parent vs new joint weights. Keep per-game quota and timing fixed across frozen arms. Report outcomes by title separately; TH12 first-life time restricted to 40 wall seconds, TH13 settled spares by 60 wall seconds. Uncontrolled native RNG. Do not combine old and new native clocks or treat two pairs as a policy promotion.
architecture: Same 255 parameters, samples left/neutral/right from original pixel crops, shoot held. No automatic bomb, aim assistance or geometric controller.
